entries.name: PerformanceDiag
entries.description: PERFDIAG.R4X captures a passive baseline, isolates active R4DEV checks under /CONFORMANCE, and provides repeated BLIT, CLOCK, SERVICE-REGISTRY, KERNEL-IPC, DRIVER-WORK, PCI-INVENTORY, and MEMORY-METADATA benchmarks. DRIVER-WORK keeps its comparable fixed audio load while requiring snapshot v2 and exposing deadline queue time, misses, lateness, budget overruns and rejections. The memory mode separates eight-page reserve/commit, demand-fault, Page-State, and multi-frame reclaim phases while preserving physical-block, range, local-span, and reclaim-cursor steps plus rollback and rebuild gates. Storage records expose multi-sector writes, selective writeback, retained foreign dirty sectors, bounded background/read-ahead Pagecache policy metrics, and fixed NTFS metadata-cache budgets with hit, invalidation, and reclaim deltas. All modes preserve raw counters, tail distributions, checks, and versioned NDJSON v7 results.
